title: Assistant Professor of Economics (Microeconomic Theory and/or Industrial Organization)
description:
Assistant Professor of Economics (Microeconomic Theory and/or Industrial Organization)

 

University of Virginia: UVA Provost's Office: College and Graduate School of Arts & Sciences: Economics

 

Location

 

Charlottesville, VA

 

Open Date

 

Sep 14, 2026

 

 

 

The Department of Economics at the University of Virginia invites applications for a full-time faculty position on the tenure track, beginning August 10, 2027, at the Assistant Professor rank. This search will consider candidates in the fields of microeconomic theory and/or industrial organization.

We seek candidates with the skills and experience to advance the research and teaching mission in a world-class institution. The Department aims to recruit faculty dedicated to building and extending a top-tier research portfolio. We value ambitious scholars equipped to build on the intellectually vibrant community of economists at the University. The duties of the position include teaching three courses per year in addition to advising, mentoring, and service.

Qualifications

Candidates must have received a Ph.D. by the start of the appointment. A successful candidate will show a strong research record and an ability to teach and advise effectively at the undergraduate and graduate levels.

Application Instructions

Review of applications will begin November 10th. To receive full consideration, applications must be received by that date. The position will remain open until filled.

Apply here https://apply.interfolio.com/190672

 

Applicants must submit the following materials:
 

 

A cover letter Curriculum vitae One research paper Three confidential letters of recommendation that discuss the applicant’s potential for research output, teaching, advising, and other professional service.
The Department of Economics has multiple searches across different fields. When submitting materials on Interfolio, please ensure you are applying to the correct position.

Questions about the application process should be directed to: Margaret Weeks, Faculty Search Advisor, at mew7ys@virginia.edu. Questions about the position should be directed to Simon Anderson at sa9w@virginia.edu. The university will perform background checks on all new faculty hires prior to making a final offer of employment.

Equal Employment Opportunity Statement

The University of Virginia is an equal opportunity employer. All interested persons are encouraged to apply, including veterans and individuals with disabilities. Learn more about UVA’s commitment to non-discrimination and equal opportunity employment.

 

https://eocr.virginia.edu/notice-non-discrimination-and-equal-opportunity
